 Game Thread | South Carolina State vs. Notre Dame
 Notre Dame is back in action as South Carolina State comes to Purcell Pavilion. 
 By Matt Freeman 
 November 11, 2026 
 3.0k Views

 Photo by Keira Jones | ISD 
 South Carolina State (3-0) vs. Notre Dame (3-0)  
 Date:  November 11
 Time:  7:00 PM ET 
 Where:  Purcell Pavilion | South Bend, Ind. 
 TV:  ACC Network Extra | Tony Simeone and Bill Fenlon
 Spread : Notre Dame -25-5
 Total : 148.5
 QUICK FACTS  
 - The two programs will be meeting for the first time on Wednesday night.
 - Notre Dame’s 24-0 run vs. Eastern Illinois was the longest of the Shrewsberry era. 
 - KenPom currently ranks Notre Dame No. 72.
 - Braeden Smith is one assist shy of 500 career assists. 
 - The Fighting Irish are six wins away from 2,000 as a program.
